phase: 11 -- owned data first: every Atlas-owned artifact that could already know Dallas, Fort Worth, DFW Airport or any Metroplex suburb, measured before new acquisition
headline: Every committed market graph was scanned for a node in this market's 229 admitted postal codes (count below). Dallas-Fort Worth is the first North Texas market: owned identities and owned policy are measured, not assumed.
a_brand_prefix_is_not_a_market: Marriott's DAL and DFW prefixes cover Dallas, Fort Worth, the airport and every suburb AND Denton, Rockwall, Waxahachie, Weatherford and Sherman, and a prefix never decides membership. A route carries no postal code, so every route is a LEAD with a PRESUMED disposition read off the brand's own slug.

live_identity_names.what_it_is: The normalised canonical name of every identity every registered market publishes. No live market has Metroplex premises, so a DFW row can collide with a live market ONLY by name; the census holds any DFW row whose own normalised name is already published elsewhere.

cross_market_name_collision_guard.what_this_order_does_about_it: MEASURES it and hands the strings to the census reconciliation as a named guard, which HOLDS rather than silently drops any hit. This order does NOT edit the shared exclusion file.

provider_history.pay_once_rule: Every URL this order is about to buy is checked against these ledgers first.
provider_history.refusals_are_treated_as_stale: A prior refusal ages in days and is re-probed, never inherited.

owned_osm_extract.note: Owned: the Austin order's 2026-09-30 Geofabrik Texas extract is hard-linked into this worktree at zero requests (the OSM lane's PBFS entry names the download's provenance).

what_is_never_reused: Membership and municipality (re-decided here) and pet policy (none is imported: every prior node in these codes was OUTSIDE its own market and unverified).
